purpose: Execute the atomic intersect-bodies operation within the MA-22 boundary: Transient Boolean intersection only. It consumes tools, does not attach/copy, and accepts only results that remain closed and nonempty under the current checks.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires intersect-bodies and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Closed nonempty transient target body mutated in place.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Nonempty list of distinct closed nonempty transient intersection bodies.

inputs.name: tool_policy
inputs.description: Must be exactly consume; this variant does not preserve tools.

preconditions: target and every tool pass require_transient.
tools is nonempty, distinct, and contains no target identity.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {body: transient Modeler.Body, piece_count: integer}; target is mutated and tools are expected to be deleted.

postconditions: Every supplied tool has IsDeleted true.
